hypothesised_pattern: A simple rule fits these samples: the target is above the base prediction when x2 and x5 have the same sign and below it when they have opposite signs.
rationale: The four positive-residual rows (targets 0.55-0.74) have x2*x5 of about 0.65, 1.14, 1.87 and 0.47, and the six negative-residual rows (targets 0.14-0.45) have x2*x5 of about -0.57, -4.57, -0.61, -0.54, -0.59 and -1.27. In these rows x4 lies between 0.26 and 0.72 in both groups and does not separate them, so the product x2*x5 is the clear driver.
